title: Analytics on dedicated replicas
statement: The system shall execute queries marked analytical only on dedicated non-voting analytics replicas that store data in the same format as voting replicas.
rationale: PO decision: dedicated same-format analytics replicas.

acceptance_criteria.text: An analytical query is never executed on a voting replica; tracing shows only analytics replicas served it.
If no analytics replica is available, an analytical query fails with an explicit error rather than falling back to voting replicas.

notes: Open: how a query is marked analytical (hint, session, separate endpoint).
